acceptance_criteria.description: Every copied accepted Test 6 profile and clock mode matches its frozen hash.
All calibration, incident, surface, fourth-order and frozen-core forecasts hash-locked before any nonlinear receiver starts.
Every nonquiet finest local cycle interval exceeds five times the combined actual AND forecast mesh/time/domain budget plus sampling and 1e-11 cycles; otherwise unresolved.
Every nonquiet finest fourth-order cycle forecast error <= max(5% of measured record, combined numerical budget); unresolved if record not resolved.
Every nonquiet finest phase, chi-response and density-response relative L2 prediction error <= max(5%, combined phase trace numerical budget).
Every grid single and pair sign-odd phase fraction <=1e-5.

On every grid chi-response weak exponent within 0.1 of 2, amplitude-normalized half/nominal/double chi traces within 5%, and half-amplitude second-order phase trace error <=5%; unresolved if interval resolution fails.
Both-minus-each-alone phase trace exceeds five combined numerical budgets and its fourth-order prediction error <=max(5%, inverse signal-to-budget); unresolved if not resolved.
Matched quiet intervals <1e-15 cycles and executed frozen-core Taylor chi coefficients <=1e-15.

For every nonquiet actual and forecast phase trace, finest mesh difference <=0.75 previous mesh difference plus time/domain/noise differences; combined relative phase numerical budget <0.2. Otherwise unresolved.
All preparations/grids: relative charge and total energy drift <1e-5; matched energy residual <1% initial incident energy.

summary.scope: Program 15.7 known-incident, fixed-local-time, fourth-order radial acceptance; old surface-only classifications unchanged

known_gaps: Known incident preparation; not a surface-only inverse or autonomous detector.
Fixed local proper-time markers and matched quiet reference in flat spherical geometry.
Refinement interpolates the frozen accepted calibration; no refit or nonspherical stability claim.
A pass is limited to Program 15.7 in this sector; Test 8 survival and recoil remain untested.
